pictures.author: Premeditated
pictures.observed: Broad pink-red brick low wall, small coping/dentils, white marble pointed portal/niches and narrow wing slits, dark-green upper panels, open lower route. The large fountain on the right is an independent foreground structure, not part of this gate.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Courtyard-side portal detail: deep pointed marble recess, paired green-grey stone shafts/stepped capitals, dark-green upper fan/rectangular panels, framed circular medallion and alternating pale/grey lower arch stones over the open brick-vaulted route. Fine inscriptions and tughra are not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Imperial Gate (Bab-i Humayun) only, second authored member of18 required Topkapi Palace structures. Broad low brick gatehouse on its particular native rectangular footprint, marble frontispieces/blind pointed niches, tall recessed pointed portals framing a genuinely open lower vaulted route, green-grey paired stone columns/stepped capitals, opaque dark-green upper panels with original geometric gold accents, stone plinth/coping and fine dentils. Inclined occupied paving follows existing front/rear standard-ground controls. No lost upper storey, twin Salutation towers, courtyard canopy, neighbouring fountain, copied calligraphy/tughra/inscription art, furnished guard rooms, visitors or temporary entry/security equipment.
